frozenPredeclaredWindows.objectCoordinates: u,v normalized to each independently registered complete table exterior, including any visible frame; xMin,xMax,yMin,yMax
frozenPredeclaredWindows.registration: Map declared envelopes through actual pane bounds. Register the complete table exterior using all visible boundary segments without choosing a model or fitting text. Missing/ambiguous boundaries hold the property; never move or enlarge an envelope after inspection.
frozenPredeclaredWindows.textRule: All glyphs of the exact named literal must be readable in its own frozen window; presence elsewhere or partial/inferred text gives zero credit.
frozenPredeclaredWindows.frameRule: Record all four connected blue exterior strokes independently from red inner vertical divider and yellow body, and corresponding control bands. A band outside its envelope or occluded is held; no inferred width/DPR. Colored presence anywhere in a broad union is insufficient.
